capabilities: Suggest inline ghost text at the cursor while writing Markdown
Accept the full line with Tab or the next word with Right Arrow
Connect to OpenRouter or Groq with separate API keys
Toggle autocomplete via command or status-bar indicator
Exclude private folders from the text sent to providers
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.13.2 or newer. main.js is not committed, so the plugin must be built from source or downloaded from a GitHub Actions artifact; no release had been published at the time of writing. OpenRouter can forward note text to an underlying model host, and requests can incur provider charges; the plugin itself has no telemetry and stores only the secret id.
problem: Obsidian's editor offers no inline AI text completion, so finishing a line or thought requires switching to an external tool.

relations.evidence: in the same spirit as GitHub Copilot in VS Code

summary: Inline AI ghost-text autocomplete for the Markdown editor, suggesting continuations at the cursor; Tab accepts the line, Right Arrow the next word.
